name: AgentRedTeam
description: An automated framework that tests AI agents against adversarial scenarios such as prompt injection, contradictory instructions, missing data, role confusion and tool failures. It scores each run with rule-based checks and an LLM judge to produce trust scores. The backend runs on FastAPI, PostgreSQL and GCP Cloud Run with CI/CD.
tags: Python · Gemini ADK · FastAPI · PostgreSQL · Docker · GCP

name: Hybrid Retrieval Service
description: A RAG-oriented search service that combines dense and sparse retrieval with Reciprocal Rank Fusion. It improved Precision@5 by 21% on a 10,000-document corpus, with sub-400 ms p95 latency and answer-grounding checks against the retrieved passages.
